name: Shadow’s Embrace (Mythic)
body:
You are a creature of darkness and a gloomy aura hides your moves.

Prerequisite(s): Shadow’s Embrace.

Benefit(s): Your shadow’s embrace ability functions now as mythic darkness. You are still able to raise or lower the illumination level of the effect, up to normal light.

Legendary Prestige, © 2023, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
